steps.description: The night market at sunset: the orange conveyor belt, six coloured lapak, and brainrots walking the belt.
Walk up to a brainrot on the belt and press E to buy it, then carry it home above your head.
Brainrots placed on your lapak pay dollars every second; the HUD shows cash, income rate, multiplier and rebirths.
The Gerobak Tsunami warning: run back to your lapak before the wall of carts sweeps the market.
